verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP docs explicitly list AI features that generate insights from user data: 'Ask questions about mailbox content', 'Ask questions about specific email threads', 'Compose emails with AI assistance', and web search augmentation via Perplexity. Community evidence corroborates this, describing Zero as an AI email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users 'chat with their inbox.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on evaluation of insight accuracy/usefulness and more detail on proactive suggestion features beyond Q&A and summarization.
